requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent
requirements.note: Degree is in environmental engineering plus a data analytics certificate, not electrical engineering, physics or applied mathematics. The cover letter explicitly states the role 'has not given me much opportunity to develop signal processing algorithms or system designs of my own' -- an acknowledged gap rather than a claim of equivalent competence.

lines.quote: I also have some familiarity with satellite and airborne platform signal processing, which I understand is part of the context for the kind of instruments Kaikuvaara builds.
French citizen, no work permit requirements within the EU.
English (working language at Meridian – all reports, presentations, and day-to-day team communication conducted in English)

requirements.name: Onsite in Oulu / relocation

lines.quote: I was deployed to a partner facility in Oulu earlier this year for a three-month field trial.

requirements.note: CV dates the Oulu field trial to April–June 2025, while the cover letter describes the same deployment as having happened 'earlier this year' -- recorded as a discrepancy in when the Oulu experience occurred, not resolved.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing production embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ running on real hardware, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing Python to production or engineering standards, if any?
Can you describe any hands-on RF test-bench measurement experience you have, such as with network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber testing, if any?
Can you describe your educational background or how you have developed equivalent competence in electrical engineering, physics, or applied mathematics, if any?
